newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips show small gains, Nasdaq firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips show small gains, Nasdaq firm.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks recovered from losses in morning trade on Thursday but the undertone was soft as investors digested slightly disappointing inflation data.

The Dow Jones industrial average was trading up about eight points, or 0.11 percent, at 7294 after dipping to a low of 7254. The Nasdaq composite rose over six points to 1342, helped by a rebound in market heavyweight Intel Corp.
"The market seems to be pausing here," Charlie White, a managing director at Avatar Associates said.
"We've had a lot of favorable data recently but the bond market doesn't seem to want to move higher," he said.
On the New York Stock Exchange, the number of advancing issues outnumbered declining issues by about five to four.
The long bond, which analysts and traders said the stock market was scrutinizing for interest rate indications, was off 2/32, well above earlier lows.

The stock market was initially thrown off an upward track by this morning's release of the Consumer Price Index. The index's core rate, which excludes food and energy, rose 0.3 percent in April, slightly above an expected 0.2 percent rise.
